makemeahanzi.definition: to extend; to reach; and; in time
shoes, footwear in general

characterDeckComponents.note: 革 (leather) shows 鞋 is typically made of leather.
圭 (guī) gives a sound distantly related to xié, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to break wind, to fart; the buttocks

characterDeckComponents.note: 尸 (body) — 屁 relates to a bodily function.
比 (bǐ) gives a sound only distantly related to pì today, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to rivet one's gaze upon; to keep eyes on

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) — staring is something done with the eyes.
丁 (dīng) gives the sound — an exact match for 盯.

makemeahanzi.definition: crowd, heap, pile, mass; to pile up; measure word for things in piles or stacks

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 堆 describes a mound or pile, often of earth or soil.
隹 (zhuī) shares the rhyme -uī with duī, though the initial has drifted from zh- to d- over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: deep, profound; depth

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — the water that is deep.
罙 (deep) — combined with water, giving 深 its meaning 'deep.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to take, to receive, to obtain; to select

etymology.hint: A hand 又 taking the ear 耳 of a fallen enemy

characterDeckComponents.note: 又 (a hand) — reaching to take hold of something.
耳 (ear) — from an ancient battlefield practice of taking a fallen enemy's ear as proof of a kill, the origin of 取's meaning 'to take, obtain.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to bite, to gnaw

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) shows 咬 relates to an action of the mouth.
交 (jiāo) gives a sound distantly related to yǎo, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: brief, short; deficient, lacking

characterDeckComponents.note: 矢 (arrow) — arrows were historically used as a measuring standard, tied to 短's meaning 'short.'
豆 (dòu) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading duǎn has diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: tense, tight, taut; firm, secure

characterDeckComponents.note: 糸 (silk/thread) — 紧 relates to something pulled taut, as thread is pulled tight when spun, giving its meaning 'tight, tense'

makemeahanzi.definition: to pierce, to penetrate, to pass through; thorough

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 透 relates to moving all the way through something.
秀 (xiù) gives a sound distantly related to tòu, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: strength, power; capability, influence

characterDeckComponents.note: 力 depicts the blade of a plow — since plowing fields took great physical effort, the shape came to represent strength or power.

makemeahanzi.definition: commander; commander-in-chief; handsome, smart

etymology.hint: An army officer carrying a weapon 刂 and a flag 巾

characterDeckComponents.note: A flag — a symbol carried by a military leader.
A weapon, showing this person's role as a military commander.

makemeahanzi.definition: to kick

characterDeckComponents.note: 足 (foot) — 踢 is an action done with the foot.
易 (yì) gives a sound distantly related to tī, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: star, planet; a point of light

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun) — 星 relates to bright heavenly bodies like the sun and stars
生 (shēng) gives a sound close to 星's reading xīng

makemeahanzi.definition: to push; to expel; to drive; to decline

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 推 relates to pushing something with the hand
隹 (zhuī) gives a loose sound connection to 推's reading tuī

meanings: to give up or abstain from sth

makemeahanzi.definition: to sever, to cut off, to interrupt

etymology.hint: Using an axe 斤 to harvest grain 米

characterDeckComponents.note: 斤 (an axe) — cutting through something.
米 (grain, in the simplified form; a bundle of thread in the traditional 斷) — the material being cut, giving 断 its meaning 'to break off, cut, sever.'

makemeahanzi.definition: hollow, empty, deserted, bare

characterDeckComponents.note: 穴 (a cave/hole) — 空 relates to an empty hollow space.
工 (gōng) gives a hint of the sound — 空 is pronounced kōng, a connection that has drifted over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to embrace, to hold in one's arms; to enfold

etymology.hint: To wrap 包 in one's arms 扌; 包 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) shows the action is done with the arms.
包 (to wrap) — wrapping your arms around something gives 抱 its meaning 'to hold, to hug.'

makemeahanzi.definition: class, squad, team, work shift

etymology.hint: Cutting 刂 a piece of jade 王 in two, symbolizing two classes

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 here is a variant of 玉 (jade), appearing once on each side of the character.
刂 (knife) — cutting a piece of jade in two, symbolizing a division into groups, gave 班 its meaning 'class, group.'

meanings: classifier for planes, large vehicles, radios etc

makemeahanzi.definition: frame, rack, stand; to prop up

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — racks and frames like 架 were traditionally built of wood.
加 (jiā) gives a rhyme close to jià, with the tone shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: holy, sacred; sage, saint

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 聖; a king 王 of listening 耳  and speaking口

characterDeckComponents.note: 圣 is the simplified form of 聖, which combined an ear (耳, listening) and a mouth (口, speaking) above a standing figure — the image of someone who listens and speaks with special insight, giving 圣 its meaning 'holy, sacred.'

makemeahanzi.definition: standard, accurate; to permit, to approve, to allow

characterDeckComponents.note: 冫 (water) — 准 originally referred to a carpenter's level using water to check flatness, extended to 'standard, accurate, level.'
隹 (zhuī) gives a sound hint — 准 is pronounced zhǔn, sharing the base sound though the vowel and tone differ somewhat.

makemeahanzi.definition: urgent, rushed; to rob, to plunder

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 抢 describes seizing or grabbing something forcefully.
仓 (cāng) is only distantly related in sound to qiǎng — both end in the -ang family, but the initial and tone have drifted apart.

makemeahanzi.definition: subject, lesson, course; classwork

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 课 relates to lessons taught through spoken instruction.
果 (guǒ) gives a sound distantly related to kè, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to recline, to lie down

characterDeckComponents.note: 身 (body) shows 躺 relates to an action of the body.
尚 (shàng) gives a sound distantly related to tǎng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: mountain, hill, peak

characterDeckComponents.note: 山 is a simple picture of three mountain peaks in a row.

makemeahanzi.definition: to agree to, to consent, to permit; ready, willing

etymology.hint: To stop 止 flexing one's muscles ⺼

characterDeckComponents.note: 止 depicts a foot coming to a stop.
⺼ (flesh, muscle) — pausing to make an effort willingly gave 肯 its meaning 'to be willing, to agree.'

makemeahanzi.definition: ache, pain; bitterness, sorrow; deeply, thoroughly

characterDeckComponents.note: 疒 (sickness) — 痛 relates to physical pain or illness
甬 (yǒng) gives a sound distantly related to 痛's reading tòng, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: relatives, parents; intimate; the hazelnut tree

etymology.hint: A tree 木 bearing fruit 立

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree) — traditionally read as a tree that has borne fruit.
立 (standing) — standing close by to watch it grow, evoking closeness and nurture, extended to 亲's meaning 'close, dear; parent, relative.'

makemeahanzi.definition: skin, hide, fur, feathers

etymology.hint: A hand using a tool 攴 to strip the hide from a carcass

characterDeckComponents.note: A drawing of a hand peeling the hide away from an animal.

makemeahanzi.definition: bird

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 烏, a bird

characterDeckComponents.note: 鸟 (a simplified form of 鳥) is a simple picture of a bird in profile — its head, wing, and tail are still visible in the strokes.

makemeahanzi.definition: crisp, refreshing; candid, frank; pleased, happy

etymology.hint: A person 大 breathing lots of fresh air 爻

characterDeckComponents.note: 大 depicts a person, arms and legs spread wide.
爻, shown twice around the person, suggests air or light flowing freely — together giving 爽 its meaning 'refreshing, clear.'

makemeahanzi.definition: circle, ring, loop; to encircle

characterDeckComponents.note: 囗 (enclosure) — 圈 describes an enclosed loop or pen, as in 'circle, corral.'
卷 (juǎn) shares the rhyme -uan with quān, though the initial has drifted from j- to q- over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to blow, to exhale, to hiss, to sigh; to praise

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 嘘 relates to a sound made with the mouth, exhaling.
虚 (xū) gives the sound — an exact match with 嘘's reading.

makemeahanzi.definition: tree; to plant; to set up, to establish

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree/wood) — 树 refers to a living tree
对 (duì) gives a sound distantly related to 树's reading shù, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: neck, nape; item; a term in an equation

characterDeckComponents.note: 页 (head) — 项 originally referred to the back of the neck, near the head, later extended to mean 'item, sum'
工 (gōng) gives a loose sound connection to 项's reading xiàng

makemeahanzi.definition: to compete, to contend; contest, race

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (shell, an ancient form of money) — 赛 originally related to offering valuables, later coming to mean 'to compete.'
宀 (mián) gives a sound distantly related to sài, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to pass on; to propagate; to transmit; summons

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — relates to 传's meaning 'to pass on, transmit,' something passed from person to person.
专 (zhuān) gives a sound hint — 传 is pronounced chuán, sharing the same rhyme though the initial consonant differs.

makemeahanzi.definition: state, province, prefecture

characterDeckComponents.note: 州 depicts small dots of land, like islands, surrounded by the curving lines of a river (川) — the origin of its meaning 'state, region.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to argue, to dispute; to annoy, to disturb

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — arguing is done vocally.
少 (shǎo) gives a sound fairly close to chǎo, sharing the rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: gains, advantage, profit, merit

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain, a growing rice or wheat plant) — 利 pictures a harvest.
刂 (knife) — cutting grain at harvest time was a clear benefit or gain, giving 利 its meaning 'profit' or 'advantage.'

makemeahanzi.definition: card, game piece; placard, signboard, tablet

characterDeckComponents.note: 片 (a thin slice/board) — 牌 names a flat board or sign, like a nameplate.
卑 (bēi) gives a sound close to pái.

makemeahanzi.definition: eight; all around, all sides

characterDeckComponents.note: Two lines curving apart from each other, originally meaning 'to divide, split' — the shape was later adopted to represent the number 'eight.'

makemeahanzi.definition: hair, fur, feathers; coarse
lucky, propitious, good

etymology.hint: The words 口 of a scholar 士

characterDeckComponents.note: 士 depicts a scholar or gentleman.
口 (mouth) — the words of a wise, respected person were seen as auspicious, giving 吉 its meaning 'lucky, good.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to incite, to irritate, to offend, to vex

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 惹 describes provoking an emotional reaction in someone.
若 (ruò) gives a sound distantly related to rě, sharing the initial r- but the rhyme has drifted over time.

meanings: to pull out from in between
to remove part of the whole

makemeahanzi.definition: to draw out, to pull out; to sprout

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 抽 describes pulling something out with the hand.
由 (yóu) gives a sound distantly related to chōu, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: best or strongest of its type

makemeahanzi.definition: king, ruler; royal; surname

etymology.hint: A man 十 bridging heaven and earth (both 一)

characterDeckComponents.note: 十 — traditionally read as a great man standing tall.
一 (the two horizontal strokes) — heaven above and earth below, which the king bridges, giving 王 its meaning 'king, monarch.'

makemeahanzi.definition: common, general, normal; always, frequently, regularly

characterDeckComponents.note: 巾 (cloth) — 常 originally referred to a long skirt or banner made of cloth, later coming to mean something 'usual' or 'ordinary.'
尚 (shàng) gives a hint of the sound — 常 is pronounced cháng, a connection that has drifted over time.
